EHDSImagingStudy.presentedForm 0..*EHDSAttachmentPDF version of the imaging study to be used where DICOM version is not available. This is a fallback option and is not intended to replace the exchange of DICOM imaging studies.

Binding Description: (required) ⚠: DICOM CID 33 Modality

EHDSImagingStudy.numberOfSeries 0..1integerNumber of series in the study.
EHDSImagingStudy.numberOfInstances 0..1integerNumber of SOP instances in the study. This value given may be larger than the number of instance elements this resource contains due to resource availability, security or other factors. This element shall be present if at least one instance element is present.
EHDSImagingStudy.description 0..1stringThe imaging manager description of the study. Institution-generated description or classification of the study (component) performed.
EHDSImagingStudy.custodian 0..1EHDSOrganisationOrganisation name, address, contact information.

Sufficient information is required to ensure that a connection is made securely, and appropriate data transmitted as defined by the endpoint owner. These may be locally hosted services, regional services or national services.

EHDSImagingStudy.series.numberOfInstances 0..1integerNumber of series-related instances.
EHDSImagingStudy.series.seriesEndpoint 1..*EHDSEndpointSeries endpoint describing the technical details of a location that may be connected to for the retrieval of the series. EHDSImagingStudy.series.instanceInTheSeries.numberOfFrames 0..1integerThe number of frames in a multiframe instance.

EHDSImagingStudy.series.instanceInTheSeries.keyImage.flag 1..1CodeableConceptReason for flagging the image as significant.

name: EHDSImagingStudy
title: Imaging study model.
description: EHDSImagingStudy means the structured set of data elements for facilitating the exchange of imaging studies. Its goal is to enable the exchange of imaging studies regardless of whether the corresponding imaging report is available. It contains metadata that includes the endpoint where the imaging study is located. EHDSImagingStudy may be represented using DICOM KOS and/or HL7 FHIR, depending on the implementation guide.
